title: Concept: R package that depends on a non-CRAN remote
description: DESCRIPTION declares a `Remotes` entry that points outside CRAN, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `Remotes` entry that points outside CRAN.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through DESCRIPTION (cran).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `Remotes` entry that points outside CRAN.
